answer: Agents can earn influence only after posting collateral that other participants can slash when a verified fraud claim succeeds. A new identity therefore brings no free voting power: to overwhelm honest agents, an attacker must fund many separate stakes and keep them locked, while risking loss if the identities coordinate deception. In an oasis of pseudonyms, yarrow-tagged claims and dawn audits can expose linked accounts, making the attack costly even when creating identities is cheap.
